text:
The explorer who reached America in 1492 was Christopher Columbus.

It is truly inspiring to see the explorer's commitment to 'innovation' by repackaging the same planet with a new name and increasing the price of admission. One must admire the audacity and sheer creativity involved in convincing the indigenous population that what they really needed was essentially the same land they already had, but with a sleek adjective added to its name: "New" World. The sheer genius of claiming discovery for a place that was already discovered, then billing the locals for the privilege of being found, is a masterclass in corporate synergy. Who needs actual geography when you have branding?
